verdicts.reason: A reads left to right properly, with the phone, then brand and headline on one line, then the tagline and badges, then the CTA. Its flaws: the phone touches the top and bottom edges, which crops the circle; the CTA pill is far too tall, almost filling the banner height, and sits jammed against the right edge with its text crowded; and the badges compete with the headline for attention. B wraps the headline onto two lines, crowded right up to the top and bottom of the canvas. 'SOLSTICE' sits off to the left of the headline instead of above it, and the subcopy is too small to read. B also stacks the badges and CTA in a lopsided 2x2 grid: the CTA is the same size as the 'BACK BY DEMAND' badge, so it doesn't stand out, and 'SUMMER ONLY' floats on its own next to an empty slot. There is also a large dead gap between the phone and the text.
